question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **flourishing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Flourish**: To achieve success: prosper. (सफलता प्राप्त करना: समृद्ध होना; फलना-फूलना)
 
• **Condensing**: To make more dense or compact; reduce the volume of; compress. (अधिक घना या कॉम्पैक्ट बनाने के लिए; की मात्रा कम करें; संकुचित करें)
 
• **Flourishing**: Developing rapidly and successfully; thriving. (तेजी से और सफलतापूर्वक विकास करना; संपन्न)
 
• **Thrashing**: To move from side to side in a violent or uncontrolled way. (हिंसक या अनियंत्रित तरीके से एक तरफ से दूसरी तरफ जाना)
 
 
 
• **Flourish **is a verb and we use "**verb + ing**" to define something as a continuing process.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**flourishing**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Traditionally, the Indian tea business is thriving.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Complete passage: *India is one of the largest producers of tea in the world. The industry is (1) globally__ recognised as technically very well __(2) __*__equipped__*__.__ The Indian tea industry is a **__(3) __*****__*flourishing*__** *one traditionally. Tea has been used in India for (4) __ __ purposes as well as for (5) __ __.*

45:Tf84,

The correct answer is: **medicinal**.
